scope: Current source-bound preparation status, durable failure delivery and logical notification recovery; no customer budget gate or final-assessment substitution.

pipeline_read_route.admission: Existing signed client HMAC timestamp nonce; trusted blueprint-webapp; selectors in signed body, never arbitrary root/path. Reuse authenticated server capture-root resolver.
rules: Read actual durable ledger and retained exact birth source/current task context; check revision again around identity verification, refuse unstable/unavailable binding.
No supplied path/root, arbitrary historical-source bootstrap, raw error/path/provider body, or returned owner personal details.
handed_off means source-stage handoff only, never assessment/native execution completion.
Missing or unconfigured source/status is unavailable/unknown, never zero or completed.

webapp_callback.admission: Mandatory raw-body signed Pipeline timestamp/HMAC; legacy bearer fallback forbidden. Strict bounded JSON object.
rules: Callback is a wake-up selector only; fetch latest Pipeline ledger status, not supplied failure truth or maxreceivedattempt.
Match current accepted browser pending/stored delivery or current bundle source, current marker/video and owner/rights/context. Historical pinned provenance alone is insufficient.
Revalidate current source/owner/rights/context in transaction; durable status and notification intent/pending-enqueue state must survive retry.
Same-source stale attempt/revision cannot replace newer status; genuine screening results and consent withdrawal keep precedence.
Fresh customer status polls and notification dispatch reread canonical current ledger; unavailable read cannot masquerade as current failure or successful processing.
Emit only after durable status/notification-intent commit. accepted is true and native_execution_complete is false.
Producer verifies typed exact-source selectors and validated status-digest/reference binding before acknowledging delivery; arbitrary HTTP 200 is insufficient.
Persist source-bound pending status delivery only after ledger commit; network outside lease lock.
Delivery retry never reopens processing/provider stages or changes failure evidence.
Reuse existing listener/reconciliation loop; no new daemon, credential or infrastructure.
Retain delivery error as private metadata; local status/processing continues if transport fails.

notifications.logical_event_identity: digest(request/capture/current producer delivery/task context/needs-attention milestone); processing retries do not create another logical notification
rules: Existing durable outbox only; no direct send or new campaign.
Current source/rights/context plus canonical failed_retryable/awaiting_inputs rechecked at dispatch; raw error never included.
Tests only local sink/fake transport; no real customer email.

evidence_requirements: Actual before-fix absent status transport preserved; no fake completion seed.
Matched producer through signed API/customer reader + local notification sink; persistence/restart/order/source/withdrawal controls.
Required checks and independent diff review before protected merge/deploy.
No new frozen coverage credit from reused cases; new regressions reported separately.

field_formats.source_payload_sha256: 64 lowercase hexadecimal; actual worker ledger representation
field_formats.correlation_id: canonical sha256 digest bound to selectors/attempt/revision; not public display
field_formats.public_correlationId: host-derived bp-prep-16 lowercase hex from validated status digest

corrections.change: Record actual worker hash formats and distinguish canonical correlation digest from public host-derived reference. No state, severity, target or acceptance threshold changed.

Add typed post-commit source-bound callback acceptance; previously unspecified 200-body semantics could acknowledge unrelated success. Existing acceptance threshold strengthened explicitly; original coverage floors and severity rules unchanged. Historical v2 receipts retained; matched cases rerun at final candidate.
